board.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands; no state modification.

board list.rationale: Lists boards in a project; read-only query of Jira state.

epic.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands; no state modification.

epic add.rationale: Assigns issues to an epic, modifying Jira state in a bounded and reversible way.

epic create.rationale: Creates a new epic in the project; bounded state creation that is reversible.

--no-truncate.rationale: Only affects display format (show all columns); does not modify state.

epic list.rationale: Lists top 100 epics with optional filters; read-only query.

epic remove.rationale: Removes/unassigns epic from issues, modifying Jira state in a reversible way.

--force.rationale: Overwrites existing config file if present; still a bounded local config modification.

init.rationale: Creates or modifies local jira configuration file; bounded local state change.

issue.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands; no state modification.

issue assign.rationale: Changes issue assignee; modifies Jira state in a bounded and reversible way.

issue clone.rationale: Duplicates an issue creating new state in Jira; bounded operation that is reversible.

issue comment.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands; no state modification.

issue comment add.rationale: Adds a comment to a Jira issue — modifies issue state in a bounded, expected, and reversible way.

issue create.rationale: Creates a new issue in the project; bounded state creation that is reversible.

--cascade.rationale: Expands deletion to include subtasks; broader destructive blast radius.

issue delete.rationale: Deletes an issue from Jira; destructive, irreversible operation that removes data.

issue edit.rationale: Modifies issue fields; bounded state change that is reversible.

issue link.rationale: Creates a link relationship between two issues, modifying their connection state.

issue link remote.rationale: Adds a web link to a Jira issue — modifies issue state in a bounded, expected, and reversible way.

--no-truncate.rationale: Only affects output formatting of the display, not state.

issue list.rationale: Lists issues in a project without modifying any state.

issue move.rationale: Transitions an issue to a new state; can also modify assignee, resolution, and add comments.

issue unlink.rationale: Removes an existing link relationship between two issues.

issue view.rationale: Displays issue contents without modifying any state.

issue watch.rationale: Adds a user to an issue's watchers, modifying the issue's state.

issue worklog.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands when invoked without arguments.

issue worklog add.rationale: Adds a worklog entry to a Jira issue — modifies time-tracking state in a bounded, expected, and reversible way.

me.rationale: Displays configured Jira user information without modification.

open.rationale: Opens an issue in a browser; performs no state modification.

project.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands when invoked without arguments.

project list.rationale: Lists Jira projects the user has access to without modification.

release.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands when invoked without arguments.

release list.rationale: Lists Jira project versions without modification.

serverinfo.rationale: Displays server information about the Jira instance without modification.

sprint.rationale: Container command that displays available subcommands when invoked without arguments.

sprint add.rationale: Assigns issues to a sprint; modifies state in a bounded and reversible way.

sprint close.rationale: Closes a sprint, an irreversible action with broad workflow implications that should require human confirmation.

--no-truncate.rationale: Only affects display formatting of results.

--show-all-issues.rationale: Only filters which information is displayed, no state modification.

sprint list.rationale: Lists and displays sprint information without modifying state.
